name: langgraph-router
title: LangGraph Router (conditional-edge routing with fork)
description: A 4-node conditional-routing graph: classify → route → (general_answer | technical_answer) → finalize. The parent run takes the 'general' branch; a fork at the classify node flips the category to 'technical', causing the same router to walk the 'technical_answer' branch instead. Demonstrates how Chronos captures branch-divergent fork-children and how `chronos diff` surfaces the resulting answer-style change. Synthetic illustrative usage numbers (no real LLM calls).
